🍂🐾 Today was one for the books at Oktoberfest in Nashville at the legendary Dachshund Derby. 🐶🎉 Little Ollie didn’t race this year but he was right there with his tribe of wiener dogs soaking up the excitement. There’s nothing quite like being surrounded by wagging tails and happy people cheering them on.  

Fall festivals in this city are the best with bratwursts sizzling, funnel cakes dusted with sugar, crisp beer in hand, and live music filling the streets. 🍺🥨🎶  

Grateful for days like this where community, tradition, and fun all come together. Nashville knows how to celebrate the season. 🍁✨  

Already looking forward to the next adventure with my little guy and all the festive vibes this city has to offer. ❤️🐾
